# automox_policies (Data Source)

Policies in the configured organization.

Policy `configuration` is not returned. It varies by policy type and carries worklet source code, which would then be written to Terraform state for every policy in the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "automox_policies" "worklets" {
  # "custom" is the wire name for a worklet.
  policy_type = "custom"
}

output "worklet_names" {
  value = [for p in data.automox_policies.worklets.policies : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the policy with this exact name.
- `policy_type` (String) Return only policies of this kind: `patch`, `custom` (worklet), or `required_software`.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `next_remediation` (String)
- `notes` (String)
- `policy_type` (String) `patch`, `custom` (worklet), or `required_software`.
- `schedule_days` (Number) Encoded day-of-week bitmask. 0 means the policy is never scheduled.
- `schedule_months` (Number)
- `schedule_time` (String)
- `server_count` (Number) Devices this policy currently applies to.
- `server_groups` (List of Number) IDs of the groups this policy targets.
- `status` (String)
- `uuid` (String)
